item.title: PulseMRR 0.9.1
item.description:
Real MRR and trials

A new section at the top of the dashboard, after the admin boards of BeReach and Viewlify:

  • The real MRR of the last 30 days, day by day, then the coming days until the last running trial ends: once if every trial pays, once at your real conversion rate. Subscribers set to cancel drop out on their date.
  • Under the curve, each day's new paying customers, new trials and cancelled trials.
  • On the side: the projection at the real conversion rate, what's in trial, what's at risk, and where ended trials stand today (paying, payment failed, cancelled).

From 0.9 on, PulseMRR offers this update by itself.
